purpose: Carry bounded temporal/performance context between same-origin FIELD instruments without creating a new canonical state authority.

transport.rule: Absence or failure of pulse transport never blocks an instrument's local operation.

kinds.transport: compact playback clock/features only; never audio bytes or full AUDIO MAP
kinds.operation: bounded authored/performed operation such as BLOOM/FOLD/SPLIT/RETURN
kinds.focus: bounded addressed reader focus and pace

current_bindings.effect: beat/downbeat + analyzed phrase + section witnesses may shape terrain/timing; no automatic authored topology

Explicit PULSE OFF/×2/×4/×8 maps LISTEN BPM to WPM; ?pulse=2|4|8 is a user-authored workflow entry; READFIELD may hydrate pace from the latest same-session LISTEN snapshot and visibly distinguishes LIVE vs LAST; reader focus publishes compact focus events.

current_bindings.from: LISTEN transport or same-page hashed local AUDIO MAP + local composition commits
current_bindings.effect: PULSE LINK defaults OFF. A same-page local file may supply tempo/beat/energy/phrase/section context and outranks cross-tab LISTEN while active; Two Dial retains relation/harmony/motif/form authority.

current_bindings.from: synthetic PULSE transport or existing same-session FIELD PULSE; canonical READFIELD/APERTURE focus
current_bindings.effect: PULSE may lend a visible beat witness or explicit ×4 RSVP pace; canonical APERTURE authors source focus/scale and publishes only a bounded focus witness. READ→LOCI/DATA carry is explicit human action and creates no second reader, source store, or authority.

laws: source hash/address may witness provenance; pulse never carries audio bytes
consumer behavior must be explicit or visibly optional
RETURN/export remains the durable evidence boundary
borrowed clock != borrowed authorship; a consumer may follow temporal context without delegating its transformation grammar
timing bonus != topology authority; external song phase may reward a release but cannot choose its Fold/Bloom operation
section estimate != semantic truth; consumers may use section bounds as optional temporal apertures but must not invalidate local actions
workflow entry is explicit intent, not delegated authority; a link may enable an already-defined optional adapter but cannot change the consumer's transformation grammar
phrase estimate != semantic truth; novelty/grid evidence may open a temporal aperture but cannot name musical meaning or author a consumer operation
IDLE witness events are not authored operations; preview automation must not publish as human FIELD action

external_media_boundary.suno: Best-effort address adapter only. Real phone use on 2026-09-22 remained browser/CORS-blocked; do not gate gameplay on Suno resolution. Proven fallback: obtain/export MP3 and load locally.
external_media_boundary.local_audio: Proven analyzable phone source for LIVE/LISTEN; MP3 same-page playback + analysis confirmed in real use on 2026-09-22.
external_media_boundary.youtube: Candidate playback/link adapter; do not pretend iframe media exposes raw audio analysis.
external_media_boundary.spotify: Publishing/listening target only for this visual synchronization path; do not synchronize Spotify recordings to FIELD visuals via Spotify developer tooling.
external_media_boundary.self_hosted: Same-origin owned audio is a lawful future source when licensing/storage are explicit.
